title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: A roadmap for securing cloud systems across AWS, Azure, and GCP: identity, network controls, logging, posture management, DevSecOps, and incident response.

tree.name: Cloud and Security Foundations
tree.description: Build the base: cloud shared responsibility, Linux, networking, IAM, encryption, logging, threat models, and security operations.

children.name: Shared Responsibility and Threat Models
children.description: Map which controls belong to the cloud provider, platform team, app team, and security team for every workload.

children.name: Cloud Network Security
children.description: Secure VPC/VNet design, subnets, routing, security groups, firewalls, private endpoints, DNS, TLS, and zero-trust access paths.

tree.name: Identity, Access, and Posture Management
tree.description: Control blast radius through least privilege, MFA, workload identities, permission reviews, guardrails, and continuous posture checks.

resources.title: AWS Tutorial with IAM and Security Section (Simplilearn)
Azure Identity and Access Security Best Practices

children.name: IAM and Least Privilege
children.description: Design users, groups, roles, policies, permission boundaries, federation, service identities, secrets, and temporary credentials.

children.name: CSPM and Configuration Governance
children.description: Use policy-as-code, asset inventory, baseline controls, compliance mappings, exception workflows, and remediation tracking.

children.name: Practice: IAM Policy Review Lab
children.description: Review overly broad permissions, rewrite policies to least privilege, document risks, and add tests or guardrails to prevent regression.

tree.name: Detection, Logging, and Incident Response
tree.description: Collect cloud logs, detect suspicious activity, investigate findings, preserve evidence, and automate response workflows.

resources.title: AWS Security Best Practices (Amazon Web Services)

children.name: Cloud Logging and Threat Detection
children.description: Enable audit logs, flow logs, object access logs, GuardDuty or Defender alerts, SIEM forwarding, and alert triage playbooks.

children.name: Cloud Incident Response
children.description: Practice credential containment, snapshot preservation, key rotation, compromised instance isolation, root-cause timelines, and postmortems.

tree.name: DevSecOps, Containers, and Portfolio
tree.description: Shift security into delivery pipelines with IaC scanning, container security, secrets checks, supply-chain controls, and practical portfolio proof.

resources.title: The Cloud Experience with Ashish Rajan

children.name: IaC and Container Security
children.description: Scan Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, images, dependencies, and secrets before deployment; enforce policy gates in CI/CD.

children.name: Compliance, Privacy, and Risk Reporting
children.description: Connect controls to frameworks, classify data, track exceptions, write risk summaries, and communicate findings to engineering leaders.

children.name: Project: Secure Cloud Baseline
children.description: Create a small cloud account baseline with IAM guardrails, private networking, logging, Security Hub or Defender alerts, IaC scans, and an incident runbook.
